integrity: The proof is bound-free and exhausts the possible prime, prime-square, and distinct-semiprime shapes of the odd member after reducing the even member to 2, 4, or twice an odd prime. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only consecutive equal Carmichael-function values with both arguments in the Omega-at-most-two layer. It does not classify unrestricted consecutive coincidences.
title: The two-almost-prime layer of consecutive Carmichael-function coincidences
